predicate.text: 按基础输入价格的十分之一

evidence.source_text: On the Claude API, Claude Platform on AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Foundry, the minimum cacheable prompt length is: 512 tokens for Claude Opus 5, Claude Fable 5, and Claude Mythos 5; 1,024 tokens for Claude Opus 4.8, Claude Sonnet 5, Claude Sonnet 4.6, Claude Sonnet 4.5. By default, the cache has a 5-minute lifetime. The previous table reflects the following pricing multipliers for prompt caching: 5-minute cache write tokens are 1.25 times the base input tokens price; 1-hour cache write tokens are 2 times the base input tokens price; Cache read tokens are 0.1 times the base input tokens price.

quote.text: Cache read tokens are 0.1 times the base input tokens price

adversarial_reviews.evidence_fragment: Cache read tokens are 0.1 times the base input tokens price.
adversarial_reviews.strongest_counter_reading: One could argue the evidence applies only to specific platforms (Claude API, Claude Platform on AWS, Google Cloud, Microsoft Foundry) and the claim might be intended to apply more broadly, or that translation differences between '基础输入价格' and 'base input tokens price' introduce ambiguity about what constitutes the base price.
adversarial_reviews.what_would_falsify: Check the current Claude API pricing page (api.anthropic.com/pricing or the official documentation URL cited in the source) to verify whether cache read tokens are charged at a different multiplier than 0.1x, or whether the multiplier varies by platform, model, or cache duration.
